title: Ali Siddiq: My Two Sons
overview: Ali Siddiq tells true stories and breaks down the differences between his 'old son' and his 'new son', and spoiler, one of them is much better than the other. In a break from the hugely successful 4 part Domino Effect series, which has over 35 million views on YouTube, this new special gives a look into Ali's family life, his sometimes unconventional parenting strategies, and his role as a father of 9 children.
